# Mote v1.1.0 - Windows Desktop

Mote is a minimal, local-first Markdown note app. With v1.1.0, Mote is available as a Windows desktop application alongside its existing Web/PWA.

This stable release promotes the v1.1.0-rc.1 desktop preview after initial real-Windows testing. No new editor features or data migrations are introduced since the release candidate.

## Download

**Windows x64:** Download `Mote_1.1.0_x64-setup.exe` from **Assets** below.

- Download and run the NSIS installer.
- The installer is currently **not code signed**. Windows SmartScreen may display an unknown-publisher warning.
- Use `SHA256SUMS.txt` to verify the downloaded installer if desired.

**Web/PWA:** https://mote.namnth.com

## Highlights

- Native Windows desktop window powered by Tauri 2 and the existing Mote UI.
- Write and organize Markdown notes with auto save, Preview, Mermaid and syntax highlighting.
- Organize notes with groups, Favorites, Hidden and Trash.
- Export Markdown and JSON backups without requiring an account or cloud backend.
- Offline local-first workflow.

## Existing notes and upgrades

- **Web/PWA and Desktop do not share storage.** To move existing notes, export a JSON backup from one and import it into the other. Importing replaces the destination library.
- When upgrading from the desktop release candidate, back up important notes before installing the stable version. The Tauri application identifier is unchanged.
- Keep a copy of your notes in a JSON backup, especially before resetting Windows, clearing application data or uninstalling.

## Known limitations

- The Windows installer is unsigned and may trigger SmartScreen.
- No built-in sync or automatic desktop updates.
- Please report any Windows-specific import/export, PDF/printing or upgrade issues at https://github.com/namnth2000/mote/issues.

Thanks for trying Mote.
